result.instructions: Tools for Shopify, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which products are low on stock at our main warehouse?"; "Show me the orders from yesterday that are still unfulfilled."; "How many active products do we have from the vendor Acme?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Shopify data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run shopify_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run shopify_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run shopify_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. shopify_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: shopify_get_shop
tools.title: Get store details
tools.description: Return the store name, myshopify domain, currency, time zone, Shopify plan and primary domain. Good first call to confirm which store is connected. Admin API: shop.

tools.name: shopify_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: List products with status, vendor, product type, total inventory and last update. Filter with Shopify search syntax, for example 'status:active'. Admin API: products.

query.description: Shopify search syntax, for example 'status:active vendor:Acme' or 'updated_at:>2026-01-01'.

after.description: Cursor from pageInfo.endCursor of the previous page.

tools.name: shopify_get_product
tools.title: Get product
tools.description: Return one product with its first 50 variants: SKU, price, stock quantity and inventory item id. Admin API: product(id).

product_id.description: Numeric id or gid of the resource.

tools.name: shopify_count_products
tools.title: Count products
tools.description: Count products that match a Shopify search query, for example 'status:active'. Counts above 10,000 are capped. Admin API: productsCount.

query.description: Shopify search syntax, for example 'status:active vendor:Acme' or 'updated_at:>2026-01-01'.

tools.name: shopify_list_collections
tools.title: List collections
tools.description: List product collections with handle and product count. Admin API: collections.

query.description: Shopify search syntax, for example 'status:active vendor:Acme' or 'updated_at:>2026-01-01'.

after.description: Cursor from pageInfo.endCursor of the previous page.

tools.name: shopify_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders with payment and fulfillment status and total price. No customer personal data is returned. Only the last 60 days unless the app has read_all_orders. Admin API: orders.

query.description: Shopify search syntax, for example 'status:active vendor:Acme' or 'updated_at:>2026-01-01'.

after.description: Cursor from pageInfo.endCursor of the previous page.

tools.name: shopify_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Return one order with its payment and fulfillment status, cancellation details, total and first 50 line items (title, quantity, SKU). No customer personal data. Admin API: order(id).

order_id.description: Numeric id or gid of the resource.

tools.name: shopify_list_locations
tools.title: List locations
tools.description: List inventory locations with active state and whether they ship inventory. Set include_inactive to also list deactivated locations. Admin API: locations.

after.description: Cursor from pageInfo.endCursor of the previous page.

tools.name: shopify_get_inventory_levels
tools.title: Get inventory levels
tools.description: List stock levels at one location: available, on hand, committed and incoming quantities per inventory item, with SKU. Read the current available quantity here before calling shopify_set_inventory_quantity. Admin API: location(id).inventoryLevels.

location_id.description: Numeric id or gid of the resource.

query.description: Shopify search syntax, for example 'status:active vendor:Acme' or 'updated_at:>2026-01-01'.

after.description: Cursor from pageInfo.endCursor of the previous page.

tools.name: shopify_set_inventory_quantity
tools.title: Set inventory quantity
tools.description: Set the available stock of one inventory item at one location. Changes the live stock in the store. current_quantity is the available quantity you just read: the change applies only if the stock still has that value (compare-and-swap). Admin API: inventorySetQuantities.

inventory_item_id.description: Numeric id or gid of the resource.

location_id.description: Numeric id or gid of the resource.

current_quantity.description: The available quantity you read just before the change.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Shopify
prompts.description: What you can do with Shopify here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: find_products_that_are_low_on_stock
prompts.title: Find products that are low on stock
prompts.description: List products with their total inventory. Read one product to see the stock of its first 50 variants, then read the stock levels at one location.

prompts.name: review_orders_that_are_not_fulfilled_yet
prompts.title: Review orders that are not fulfilled yet
prompts.description: List recent orders with their payment and fulfillment status. Open one order to read its line items. No customer personal data is returned.

prompts.name: count_active_products_from_one_vendor
prompts.title: Count active products from one vendor
prompts.description: Count the products that match a search query such as status active and a vendor name. List the matching products to see their stock.

prompts.name: set_the_stock_of_a_variant_only_if_it_is_unchanged
prompts.title: Set the stock of a variant only if it is unchanged
prompts.description: Read the current available quantity at a location. Then set the new quantity. The change applies only if the stock still has the value you read.

prompts.name: browse_the_store_and_its_collections
prompts.title: Browse the store and its collections
prompts.description: Read the store details to confirm which store is connected. List the product collections with their product counts.
